items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I did a thing with Hazel Scott and Red Skelton called 'I Doed It'

ctx.x: The one you mentioned before, yeah. You also mentioned that you had done a film with Freddie Fisher before you had the Camel Caravan experience. What was the film you did for him, do you remember?

No, I don't recall what the name of that one was, because you see, that was at the time I was doing a lot of freelancing, and when you do a film during that time, I was specializing, too, you know, because they would call me because they had the legitimate drummers, and most of the musical things that I was doing --and it's just like any other record date, you know; you may not have a clue to the name of the movie you're going in to; as a matter of fact, you don't even care)-- because you just go in and they got…

So I wouldn't really know the name of that picture, but I did a thing with Hazel Scott and Red Skelton called 'I Doed It' -- I was in I think Lena Horne's pictures, too, I was trying to think of -- I think it was 'Panama Hattie' -- was it 'Panama Hattie' or something?
